vllm/v1/sample/rejection_sampler.py.rejection_random_sample_kernel:
req_idx = tl.program_id(0)
    is_greedy = False
    if is_greedy_ptr:
        is_greedy = tl.load(is_greedy_ptr + req_idx)
    if is_greedy:
        return

    if req_idx == 0:
        start_idx = 0
    else:
        start_idx = tl.load(cu_num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx - 1)
    end_idx = tl.load(cu_num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
    num_draft_tokens = end_idx - start_idx

    out_base = output_token_ids_ptr + req_idx * (max_spec_len + 1)
    if num_draft_tokens == 0:
        bonus_token = tl.load(bonus_token_ids_ptr + req_idx)
        tl.store(out_base, bonus_token)
        return

    accepted_prefix = 0
    while accepted_prefix < num_draft_tokens:
        token_idx = start_idx + accepted_prefix
        draft_token_id = tl.load(draft_token_ids_ptr + token_idx)
        target_prob = tl.load(target_probs_ptr + token_idx * vocab_size +
                              draft_token_id)
        if IS_NGRAM:
            draft_prob = 1.0
        else:
            draft_prob = tl.load(draft_probs_ptr + token_idx * vocab_size +
                                 draft_token_id)
        ratio = target_prob / draft_prob
        ratio = tl.minimum(ratio, 1.0)
        u = tl.load(uniform_probs_ptr + token_idx)
        if u < ratio:
            tl.store(out_base + accepted_prefix, draft_token_id)
            accepted_prefix += 1
        else:
            recovered_token = tl.load(recovered_token_ids_ptr + token_idx)
            tl.store(out_base + accepted_prefix, recovered_token)
            return

    bonus_token = tl.load(bonus_token_ids_ptr + req_idx)
    tl.store(out_base + num_draft_tokens, bonus_token)
vllm/v1/sample/rejection_sampler.py.rejection_greedy_sample_kernel:
req_idx = tl.program_id(0)
    is_greedy = True
    if is_greedy_ptr:
        is_greedy = tl.load(is_greedy_ptr + req_idx)
    if not is_greedy:
        return

    if req_idx == 0:
        start_idx = 0
    else:
        start_idx = tl.load(cu_num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx - 1)
    end_idx = tl.load(cu_num_draft_tokens_ptr + req_idx)
    num_draft_tokens = end_idx - start_idx

    offsets = tl.arange(0, MAX_SPEC_LEN)
    mask = offsets < num_draft_tokens
    draft_ids = tl.load(draft_token_ids_ptr + start_idx + offsets,
                        mask=mask,
                        other=PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN_ID)
    target_ids = tl.load(target_argmax_ptr + start_idx + offsets,
                         mask=mask,
                         other=PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN_ID)
    matched = draft_ids == target_ids
    mismatch = tl.where(mask & (~matched), 1, 0)
    first_mismatch = tl.argmax(mismatch, axis=0)
    has_mismatch = tl.sum(mismatch, axis=0) > 0
    accepted_len = tl.where(has_mismatch, first_mismatch, num_draft_tokens)

    out_base = output_token_ids_ptr + req_idx * (max_spec_len + 1)
    accept_mask = offsets < accepted_len
    tl.store(out_base + offsets, draft_ids, mask=accept_mask)

    if has_mismatch:
        rej_token = tl.load(target_argmax_ptr + start_idx + accepted_len)
        tl.store(out_base + accepted_len, rej_token)
    else:
        bonus_token = tl.load(bonus_token_ids_ptr + req_idx)
        tl.store(out_base + num_draft_tokens, bonus_token)
